Production registry integration is restricted to instantiated environment descendants; quest props, dynamic actors, chest bodies/lids and projectile paths remain outside this registration.
Visibility shadow candidates intentionally ignore camera frustum. Main-camera rejection must not be shared with shadow/render-target/secondary-camera candidate selection.
Custom provider subsets, FrameGraph and multiple active cameras require native passthrough. Provider disposal must restore only its own installed function and preserve retained external wrappers.

Late geometry/material/submesh/skeleton/morph/action/method attachment to an empty root must immediately fail open. Mesh API add/remove and ancestor effective-enabled events must invalidate exact ordered candidates.

A focused production-source search found zero direct scene.meshes sort/reverse/splice/push/pop/shift/unshift calls, assignments or indexed assignments. Arbitrary foreign direct array mutation is audited separately rather than represented as a supported event contract.
